name: 2015-16 Demographic Data - Admissions Methods
description:
This dataset lists New York City public schools and the admissions methods they used for the 2015-16 school year. Each row pairs a school's district-borough-number code (dbn) and name with a text label describing its admissions method, such as "ES: Choice District" for elementary schools admitting students by district-wide choice or "MS: Screened" for middle schools using screened admissions. With roughly 1,570 rows and 109 distinct admissions method labels, the data covers elementary, middle, and other school types across the city.

The dataset is useful for analyzing how schools select or admit students, comparing admissions approaches across districts or school levels, and mapping which schools rely on choice, screening, or other methods. It could support research on school choice policy, equity in admissions, or planning for families navigating enrollment, and it can be joined to other school-level datasets via the dbn identifier.
